_doc: Per-donor icon specs for the v4 cameras (fit_v4.py), from a review of icon_overrides_review.png (item numbers of that review in 'todo'). ref: the donor's ORIGINAL icon (materials-relative, no .vtf; team variants resolved red-first) when its own image_inventory is missing or wrong - TF2C install content only (stock vgui/loadout icons, tf2cc's icons for the old Merc / Open Fortress weapons). model_kind: 'v' = view model in its idle pose. arms: arms model bonemerged onto the view model, as the original icon shows them. hide: material / bone name substrings the original icon does not show. upright: keep the model's up axis vertical (simple side view). Every entry says why.
